jobs.title: Sr Implementation Consultant
jobs.description:
Veradigm DORN is a cloud\-based diagnostic ordering and results network that gives EHR partners a single integration point into a growing network of 500\+ laboratory and radiology centers. Instead of building and maintaining a custom interface for every lab or imaging center, EHRs connect once to DORN and gain standardized, HL7\-based order and results connectivity across the network.


The Senior Implementation Consultant leads technical integration projects for Veradigm DORN across laboratory, radiology, and EHR partners. This role owns projects end to end, from kickoff through production certification, managing both net\-new integrations and partner transitions. The consultant also maintains lab and radiology test compendiums and supports EHR partners as they onboard and test new labs and radiology centers on the network.


Required Qualifications:


* 5\+ years of experience in healthcare IT implementation, integration, or technical project management, ideally involving labs, radiology, or EHR systems.
* Hands\-on experience with HL7 messaging (orders and results) and API\-based integrations.
* Working knowledge of laboratory or radiology order/results workflows, including test compendiums and result mapping.
* Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent implementation projects with competing timelines and stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience leading meetings with external partners and technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Comfortable working directly with EHR vendors, lab/radiology partners, and internal engineering, product, and support teams.

Preferred Qualifications:


* Prior experience with Veradigm products (DORN, Veradigm EHR, Practice Fusion) or comparable diagnostic connectivity platforms.
* Familiarity with reference lab operations (e.g., LabCorp, Quest Diagnostics) or radiology/imaging center workflows.
* Experience managing EHR\-to\-lab or EHR\-to\-radiology integration migrations or platform transitions.
* PMP, CAPM, or equivalent project management certification.

What You'll Contribute:


* Manage the full lifecycle of net\-new and transition integration projects for DORN lab, radiology, and EHR partners, from kickoff and technical scoping through QA certification and go\-live.
* Lead technical design discussions with partners to translate clinical and operational requirements into a working DORN integration, using API and HL7 (order and results messaging) standards.
* Build and maintain project schedules, milestones, and status reporting; run kickoff calls, weekly status meetings, and risk/issue tracking for each active engagement.
* Own and maintain lab and radiology compendiums, ensuring test/order codes, result formats, and mappings stay accurate and current for each connected lab or radiology center.
* Support EHR partners in onboarding and testing new labs and radiology centers via DORN, including test plan execution, QA demo review, and production certification.
* Coordinate with laboratory and radiology partners (e.g., LabCorp, Quest Diagnostics, regional and hospital labs, imaging centers) on connectivity requirements, transaction fee structures, and go\-live readiness.
* Troubleshoot integration issues during implementation and early production, partnering with engineering and support teams to resolve order/result transmission problems.
* Identify and escalate project risks, scope changes, and delays; manage change orders in coordination with account and product teams.
* Provide implementation\-led support during the post\-certification stabilization period, and hand off cleanly to ongoing support once a partner reaches steady state.
* Document integration decisions, configurations, and lessons learned to improve repeatability across future DORN implementations.

jobs.description:
**Clinical Implementation \& Customer Success Manager**

About MedGEO

MedGEO is a healthcare technology company transforming how procedural care is documented, understood, and optimized at the point of care. Built by clinicians for clinicians, MedGEO combines intelligent automation, AI, and Smart Vision technology to reduce documentation burden, improve data accuracy, strengthen compliance, and provide healthcare organizations with greater visibility into the clinical, operational, and financial performance of procedural care.

Our technology works directly within operating rooms and procedural environments, helping nurses and clinicians spend less time on administrative tasks and more time focused on patients.

About the Role

MedGEO is seeking a highly motivated **Clinical Implementation \& Customer Success Manager** to lead customer onboarding, clinical implementation, training, go\-live support, adoption, and ongoing customer success for our healthcare technology platform.

This role requires a **nursing background**, with **operating room, perioperative, surgical services, or procedural\-care experience strongly preferred**. The ideal candidate understands the realities of surgical workflows, clinical documentation, supplies, implants, preference cards, physician and nursing workflows, and the operational demands placed on OR teams.

You will serve as a primary point of contact for customers, helping clinical teams successfully adopt MedGEO’s technology and ensuring customers achieve meaningful clinical, operational, and financial value. This is a hands\-on, customer\-facing role that requires strong communication, project management, technical aptitude, and the ability to work closely with hospital teams as well as MedGEO’s Product, Engineering, Sales, and leadership teams.

This role requires onsite travel for implementations and go\-lives, with expected travel ranging from approximately **20% to 50% of the time**, depending on customer growth, implementation schedules, go\-live activity, and business needs.

Because MedGEO is still in an early and formative stage of growth, this role also includes the opportunity to participate in the company’s long\-term upside through **early equity in the company**. We are looking for someone who wants to help build the customer success and implementation function, contribute meaningfully to the company’s growth, and share in the value they help create as MedGEO scales.

The right person will be comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment, rolling up their sleeves during implementations and go\-lives, and helping build the customer success function as MedGEO grows.

Key ResponsibilitiesClinical Implementation \& Go\-Live Support

* Lead end\-to\-end clinical implementation processes, including planning, workflow assessment, training, go\-live readiness, launch support, and post\-launch stabilization.
* Work directly with OR nurses, surgeons, perioperative leaders, hospital administrators, IT, supply chain, revenue cycle, and other customer stakeholders.
* Assess current clinical workflows and determine how MedGEO should be incorporated into existing surgical and procedural processes.
* Support implementation of MedGEO workflows related to surgical documentation, supplies, implants, preference cards, intraoperative resource utilization, Smart Vision, and related platform capabilities.
* Develop implementation plans, timelines, milestones, training schedules, and go\-live readiness criteria.
* Provide onsite and remote support during customer onboarding, training, go\-live, and optimization periods.
* Proactively identify implementation risks, workflow issues, adoption barriers, and customer concerns, and escalate as needed.

Customer Success \& Adoption

* Serve as a trusted clinical and operational partner for assigned customers.
* Build strong relationships with frontline clinicians, nurse managers, perioperative directors, surgeons, IT teams, supply chain, revenue cycle, and executive stakeholders.
* Monitor customer adoption, utilization, engagement, satisfaction, and workflow performance.
* Identify adoption gaps and work directly with customer teams to improve usage, training, and workflow alignment.
* Provide ongoing education and support to existing and new users.
* Communicate new MedGEO functionality, best practices, and workflow recommendations to customers.
* Help develop customer champions who can support adoption internally and serve as references for MedGEO externally.

Product Commercialization \& Voice of the Customer

* Serve as a bridge between customers and MedGEO’s Product, Engineering, Sales, and leadership teams.
* Translate frontline clinical feedback into clear product recommendations, workflow improvements, training needs, and commercialization priorities.
* Help Product and Engineering understand how MedGEO performs in real\-world OR and procedural environments.
* Identify recurring customer pain points, workflow challenges, usability issues, and opportunities for product improvement.
* Support rollout of new product capabilities, modules, Smart Vision enhancements, analytics features, and workflow tools.
* Contribute to customer\-facing materials, training resources, workflow guides, implementation playbooks, and product adoption best practices.
* Help determine whether new product features are ready for broader customer rollout based on usability, workflow fit, customer readiness, and measurable value.

Customer Value, Expansion \& Retention

* Help customers understand and measure the clinical, operational, and financial value generated by MedGEO.
* Track improvements in documentation efficiency, utilization capture, accuracy, compliance, workflow performance, and financial outcomes.
* Support customer business reviews, ROI discussions, executive updates, and account health reporting.
* Partner with Sales and leadership to identify opportunities for renewals, upsells, expansions, and additional deployments across ORs, service lines, departments, facilities, and health\-system locations.
* Support customer retention by ensuring strong adoption, responsiveness, and demonstrated value.
* Contribute to case studies, testimonials, success stories, and reference materials.

Internal Coordination \& Tools

* Use tools such as **Jira, Slack, CRM systems, project trackers, shared documentation platforms, and other workflow tools** to manage tasks, customer updates, implementation progress, product feedback, and internal communication.
* Document customer issues, workflow needs, implementation milestones, product requests, and follow\-up items clearly and consistently.
* Coordinate with Product and Engineering through Jira or similar tools to report bugs, prioritize customer\-impacting issues, and track resolution.
* Communicate effectively with internal teams through Slack, email, meetings, and project management tools.
* Maintain accurate customer records, implementation notes, account updates, risks, and action items.

Required Qualifications

* **Registered Nurse or clinical nursing background required.**
* **Operating room, perioperative, surgical services, or procedural\-care experience strongly preferred.**
* Strong understanding of OR workflows, surgical documentation, supplies, implants, preference cards, physician workflows, nursing workflows, and multidisciplinary surgical teams.
* Experience working with surgeons, OR nurses, perioperative leadership, anesthesia teams, surgical technologists, hospital administrators, IT, supply chain, or revenue cycle teams.
* Experience in clinical implementation, customer success, healthcare technology, clinical education, nursing leadership, informatics, medical device, or healthcare operations.
* Strong technical aptitude and comfort learning healthcare software platforms.
* Ability to train clinical users and explain technology in a clear, practical, workflow\-focused way.
* Familiarity with tools such as **Jira, Slack, CRM systems, project management tools, and shared documentation platforms**.
* Strong project management, organizational, and follow\-through skills.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple customer implementations, priorities, and internal stakeholders at the same time.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both frontline clinicians and executive hospital leadership.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup environment where priorities can evolve quickly.
* Willingness and ability to travel approximately **20% to 50%** for implementations, training, go\-lives, workflow assessments, and customer optimization.

Preferred Qualifications

* CNOR certification or prior circulating OR nurse experience.
* Experience as an OR nurse manager, clinical educator, perioperative coordinator, surgical services leader, or clinical informatics specialist.
* Experience implementing healthcare technology, EHR systems, perioperative systems, medical device software, or digital workflow solutions.
* Familiarity with Epic OpTime, HST, SIS, Cerner, or other perioperative or procedural systems.
* Experience with implant\-heavy specialties such as orthopedics, spine, cardiovascular, plastics, oral surgery, or other procedural service lines.
* Experience working with hospital IT, supply chain, revenue cycle, clinical operations, or clinical informatics teams.
* Previous experience in customer success, clinical implementation, clinical solutions, or healthcare SaaS is highly valuable.

Who Will Thrive at MedGEO

The right person for this role understands the operating room because they have worked in or around one. You can walk into a procedural environment, understand what the clinical team is doing, identify where documentation or workflow gaps occur, and translate those observations into practical recommendations for customers and internal teams.

You are clinically credible, technically curious, highly organized, and comfortable communicating with everyone from frontline nurses to surgeons, administrators, engineers, and executives. You are willing to roll up your sleeves during go\-lives, solve problems in real time, and help build the customer success function as MedGEO grows.

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to combine nursing experience, healthcare technology, customer leadership, implementation, and product commercialization in a high\-impact role at an early\-stage company.

**Summary**
-----------


This position is in the Defense Civilian Personnel Advisory Service (DCPAS) organization and Personnel Readiness Management Agency (PRMA). PRMA is a Department of War (DoW) Field Activity, of the Under Secretary of War (Personnel and Readiness) (USW (P\&R)). The position will be filled as a TERM Not to Exceed September 30, 2028\. Agency has the option to extend TERM Appointments up to 4 years.


Learn more about this agency


  
**This job is open to**
-----------------------


### **The public**


U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.
### **Career transition (CTAP, ICTAP, RPL)**


Federal employees whose job, agency or department was eliminated and are eligible for priority over other applicants.
### **Military spouses**


Military spouses of active duty service members or whose spouse is 100 percent disabled or died on active duty.
### **Clarification from the agency**


All U.S. Citizens


  
**Duties**
----------


As a Training Specialist at the GS\-1712\-13 some of your typical work assignments may include:


* Serve as the principal Training Specialist and Program Manager, leading the strategy, design, and implementation of centralized talent management, leadership development, and core competency training programs across the enterprise.
* Proactively conduct organizational gap analyses to identify current and future workforce skill requirements, ensuring all curriculum and training resources are tailored to sustain a modernized, mission\-ready force.
* Manage and direct dedicated teams of contracted instructional designers and trainers, serving as the technical advisor to evaluate vendor performance, manage budgets, and ensure deliverables meet strict quality and schedule standards.
* Oversee the development and deployment of diverse, state\-of\-the\-art training methodologies\-including web\-based instruction, distance learning, job aids, and hands\-on workshops\-ensuring modern and compliant delivery.
* Monitor post\-deployment performance metrics and help desk trends to triage user inquiries, resolve training gaps, and implement business process improvements that enhance overall organizational performance.

  
**Requirements**
----------------


### **Conditions of employment**


* Must be a U.S. citizen
* Males born after 12\-31\-59 must be registered for Selective Service http://www.sss.gov
* Resume and supporting documents (See How To Apply)
* Suitable for Federal employment, determined by a background investigation
* May be required to successfully complete a probationary period
* Work Schedule: Fulltime
* Overtime: Occasionally
* Tour of Duty: Flexible
* Recruitment Incentives: May be authorized at management's discretion
* Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA): Exempt
* Financial Disclosure: Not Required
* Telework Eligibility: This position is telework eligible

### **Qualifications**


You may qualify at the **GS\-13**, if you fulfill the following qualifications:  

  

One year of specialized experience equivalent to the **GS\-12** grade level in the Federal service:


* Commanding of all phases of the education and training lifecycle (Analysis, Design, Development, Implementation, and Evaluation) to manage and deliver diverse administrative courses enterprise\-wide;
* Conducting comprehensive internal, external, and accreditation evaluations against prescribed, measurable standards using instructional measurement, survey design, and data analysis;
* Optimizing technical training support and institutional capabilities using Learning Management Systems (LMS) and emerging educational technologies;
* Leveraging evaluation data and instructional measurement techniques to establish or modify guidelines, develop innovative solutions, and drive continuous agency\-wide process improvements;
* Building mutually satisfying solutions that align with the varying, complex mission requirements of the enterprise by applying communication, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills.

*Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.*  

In addition to meeting qualifications, your application package must reflect the applicable experience to meet the Individual Occupational Requirements for the 1712 series:


A. Education


* *Undergraduate and Graduate Education:* Major study \- education or a subject area related to the position to be filled.


**OR**  

  

B. Experience that demonstrated a practical knowledge of the subject area of the position and of the methods and techniques of instruction. Examples of qualifying specialized experience include:


* Teaching or instructing in an adult education program, secondary school, college, military installation, or industrial establishment in the appropriate field(s).
* Supervising or administering a training program.
* Development or review of training/course materials, aids, devices, etc., and evaluation of training results.
* Work in the occupation or subject\-matter field of the position to be filled that required training or instructing others on a regular basis.


### **Education**


Substitution of education may not be used in lieu of specialized experience for this grade level.  

  

**ARE YOU USING YOUR EDUCATION TO QUALIFY?** You MUST provide transcripts or other documentation to support your educational claims. Unofficial transcripts are acceptable at time of application.  

  

All materials must be submitted by the closing date of the announcement.  

  

**GRADUATE EDUCATION:** One academic year of graduate education is considered to be the number of credits hours that your graduate school has determined to represent one academic year of full\-time study. Such study may have been performed on a full\-time or part\-time basis. If you cannot obtain your graduate school's definition of one year of graduate study, 18 semester hours (or 27 quarter hours) should be considered as satisfying the requirement for one year of full\-time graduate study.  

  

**FOREIGN EDUCATION** may be qualifying if a private organization specializing in interpreting foreign education programs has deemed the foreign education equivalent to that gained in an accredited U.S. education program or a U.S. accredited college or university has given full credit for the foreign courses.  

  

Unofficial transcripts from U.S. Department of Education accredited colleges, universities, schools, or institutions listing your name, the name of the school, the date and degree awarded, and the list of classes and credits earned are acceptable for the application process. If selected, official transcripts are required before a firm job offer is made. A photocopy of your degree/diploma is not acceptable.  

  

When relying on foreign education, submit transcripts and a copy of the equivalency evaluation results letter with a course\-by\-course listing. Documents must be in English or include an English translation. The hiring employer for this position does not evaluate degrees from foreign colleges or universities. For further information, visit: Foreign Education


### **Additional information**


**Re\-employed Annuitant:** This position does not meet criteria for re\-employed annuitants https://www.esd.whs.mil/Portals/54/Documents/DD/issuances/140025/140025\_vol300\.PDF?ver\=LQ7feWw\-8\-5DI2tceUpmgA%3d%3d  

  

You may be required to sign a "Drug Test Statement of Understanding" if you are selected for this position.  

  

**All applicants must meet qualifications and eligibility criteria by the closing date of the announcement.**  

  

**Interagency Career Transition Assistance Programs (****ICTAP eligibility****)****:** This program applies to employees who have been involuntarily separated from a Federal service position within the competitive service or Federal service employees whose positions have been deemed surplus or no longer needed. To receive selection priority for this position, you must: 1\) meet ICTAP eligibility criteria; 2\) be rated well\-qualified for the position; Well qualified is defined as possessing the type and quality of experience that exceeds the positions minimum qualifications. and 3\) submit the appropriate documentation to support your ICTAP eligibility. For more information:  

https://www.opm.gov/policy\-data\-oversight/workforce\-restructuring/employee\-guide\-to\-career\-transition/  

  

**Military Spouse Preference****:** If you are entitled to military spouse preference, in order to receive this preference you must choose the spousal eligibility in your application package referencing MSP Military Spouse Preference. Your preference entitlement will be verified by the employing agency. If you are claiming military spouse preference and qualified for the position, your name will be placed below preference eligible veteran candidates and above non\-preference candidates on a list sent to the hiring manager for employment consideration. To claim Military Spouse Preference (MSP) please complete the Military Spouse PPP Self\-Certification Checklist and attach it to your application package.  

  

**Priority Placement Program (PPP) DoD Retained Grade Preference****:** In order to receive this preference, you must choose to apply using the "Priority Placement Program, DoD Retained Grade Preference (RGP)" eligibility. If you are claiming RGP and are determined to be Well Qualified (score of 85 or above) for the position, you will be referred to the hiring manager as a priority applicant. jobs.description:
Who We Are:
*At UES, we’re a team of more than 4,000 engineers, scientists, geologists, inspectors, technicians, and drillers united by a shared purpose—to make a meaningful impact in the communities we serve. As a national leader in geotechnical engineering, environmental consulting, and materials testing and inspection, we collaborate on transformative projects across transportation, energy, water, healthcare, and more. Learn more about the benefits of joining Team UES and our core values at* *careers.teamues.com**.*
Position Overview:

The Learning and Development\- Field Training Specialist is responsible for supporting the design, coordination, and delivery of training programs across a defined geographic region to support employee performance, operational consistency, and business goals. This role reports to Regional HR Leadership and has a functional reporting relationship to the OD\&T Team. The role partners with HR Staff, Regional leaders, cross\-functional teams, and the OD\&T Team to identify training needs, support the design and development of training content and learning solutions, implement learning initiatives, and ensure team members are equipped with the knowledge, skills, and tools needed to succeed. The ideal candidate is an engaging facilitator, strong communicator, and organized project manager who can adapt training initiatives to meet the needs of diverse audiences.
Responsibilities:  

* Develop, coordinate, and deliver regional training programs for new hires and existing employees.
* Assess training needs in partnership with regional leadership, operations, and other stakeholders.
* Facilitate in\-person, virtual, and hybrid training sessions across multiple locations.
* Create, update, and maintain training materials, job aids, presentations, and learning resources.
* Monitor training effectiveness through evaluations, feedback, participation metrics, and performance outcomes.
* Ensure training content aligns with company policies, procedures, compliance requirements, and operational standards.
* Support onboarding initiatives and role\-specific development programs within the region.
* Partner with subject matter experts to translate business processes into practical learning content.
* Work with OD\&T Team to design, develop, and deliver learning solutions across UES.
* Track training completion, maintain accurate records, and prepare reports for leadership.
* Recommend improvements to training strategies, delivery methods, and learning tools based on regional needs and feedback.
* Serve as a training resource and point of contact for managers and employees across the region.
* Travel within the assigned region to conduct training sessions, support rollouts, and provide field coaching as needed.

  


Job Responsibilities Note:
*The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. UES retains the right to add to or change the duties of the position at any time.*Qualifications:
* Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field preferred; equivalent field experience will be considered.
* 3\+ years of experience in a training, field technician, or operations support role within engineering, construction, testing, or environmental services.
* Strong knowledge of field procedures, materials testing, inspection processes, and safety practices related to environmental and geotechnical work.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; able to coach and engage learners with varying levels of experience.
* Hands\-on training and facilitation skills; comfortable working in outdoor, active project environments.
* Ability to build trust and credibility with field staff, site supervisors, and project leads.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and familiar with digital tools used for training delivery and reporting
* Willingness to travel frequently (up to 50–75%) to various job sites and regional offices.
* OSHA 10/30 certification or related safety credentials a plus.
Preferred Qualifications:
	+ Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business Administration, or related field required.
	+ Certification in training, instructional design, talent development, or facilitation.
	+ Experience developing e\-learning content or blended learning programs.
	+ Familiarity with LMS reporting, training analytics, and performance metrics.
	+ Experience delivering training to adult learners in multiple formats, including in\-person and virtual environments.
	+ Strong presentation, facilitation, and interpersonal communication skills.
	+ Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines across a regional territory.
	+ Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
	+ Experience supporting regional or multi\-site operations.
	+ Bilingual communication skills are a plus.
Travel Requirements:
	+ This position requires extensive travel, approximately up to 70% of the time, in support of businessobjectives and client engagements. Travel may be both scheduled and on short notice, depending on
  

project needs. Destinations typically include job sites, field locations, or regional offices, where work may
  

be conducted in outdoor or operational environments. Adherence to all company safety protocols and
  

use of PPE is required during travel and on\-site work.
Physical Demands \& Work Environment:

This position primarily works in an outdoor work environment, regularly exposed to varying field conditions, including:
	+ Sites that may not be accessible by vehicle, requiring travel on foot through wetlands, swamps, grasslands, fields, and other uneven or rugged terrain with natural and man\-made obstacles such as sand, brush, and debris.
	+ Moderate to loud noise levels, common in active construction and industrial environments.
	+ Exposure to environmental elements including dirt, dust, sun, heat, humidity, and adverse weather conditions.  
	
	The physical requirements for this position may include and are not limited to:
	+ Ability to lift and/or carry 35 to 75 lbs. up to 75 feet, involving regular repetitive motion.
	+ Ability to stand, walk, drive, and operate equipment for extended periods.
	+ Frequent use of hands and arms for typing, handling tools, and operating equipment.
	+ Ability to bend, twist, reach, stoop, pull, kneel, climb, balance, lift, carry, and push as required for fieldwork and inspections.
	+ Ability to speak and hear effectively to communicate in noisy environments and with project teams.
	+ Ability to use your senses to see (including close, distant, and peripheral vison, depth vision, and ability to focus) smell, hear, touch (use hands to reach climb or balance, crouch, stoop, crawl, kneel and sit).
